items.prompt: I need ___ new laptop before the conference.
items.explanation: A singular countable noun mentioned for the first time takes the indefinite article 'a'.
The listener knows which door — definite reference, so 'the'.

items.prompt: ___ breakfast is the most important meal of the day for many people.
items.explanation: General statements about meals use the zero article.

items.prompt: She plays ___ violin in the school orchestra. Write one word.
items.explanation: Musical instruments take the definite article.

items.prompt: He's ___ honest man — you can trust him. Write one word.
items.explanation: 'Honest' starts with a vowel sound, so 'an'.

items.prompt: Find and correct the mistake: "I go to the work by train every day."
answers: I go to work by train every day
items.explanation: Here 'work' is a general activity, so it takes the zero article.
